findings.desc: Mandatory Progress UX row is broader than the surrounding state-change contract: docs/requirements/decisions/proof-or-stop-agent-prompt-consolidation-execution-plan.md:141 and :169 scope mandatory progress UX to state-changing commands, but :172 says any human-facing command that does not auto-append progress UX must run milestone_status. Current docs/CLI.md:309-315 and packages/main/src/cli-engine.ts:843-846 scope automatic append to configured story-scoped mutating commands, so the execution-plan row should be narrowed to non-auto-appended state-changing/progress-relevant commands to avoid implementing noisy or unsafe progress requirements for unrelated read-only output.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in commit 97d380f52 by narrowing the Mandatory Progress UX row to progress-relevant state-changing commands, handoffs, and final responses; unrelated read-only output is explicitly excluded.

findings.desc: Docs/code drift in Mandatory Progress UX: the plan states that when no milestone-ledger.json exists the UX must show `Checklist-derived ledger (no milestone ledger set)`, but current standalone `lattice milestone_status --storyId=B-2861` renders `Milestone Status - B-2861` with `Ledger: missing`. The checklist-derived header is implemented only in cli-engine auto-append fallback when mutating commands have no real ledger (cli-engine.ts lines 903-936; core/milestone-status.ts lines 1227-1272). The document should distinguish standalone milestone_status output from mutation auto-append fallback before this UX contract is used as implementation guidance.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in commit 97d380f52 by distinguishing standalone milestone_status Ledger: missing output from the Checklist-derived auto-append fallback used after configured mutating commands.
